attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

- id: plan-001a

  description: 'Mini signal detection (pre-screening). Run 5 episodes per candidate
    task type (2-way: internal + deterministic only) to identify which tasks show
    det > internal signal. Screen ~20 ScienceWorld task types, keep those with positive
    effect direction. ~30min per task type, ~10h total for 20 types on dual GPU.

    '
  priority: P0
  gpu_budget_hours: 10
  deps: []
  notes: 'Reviewer W3: avoid wasting GPU on no-signal tasks like grow-plant. MVP task
    types (boil, melt, change-state, mix-paint) auto-pass. grow-plant confirmed no-signal
    (control). Target: identify 10-15 task types with signal.

    '
- id: plan-001b
  claim:
  - C1
  - C2
  description: 'Episode-level counterfactual trajectory collection for death decomposition
    analysis. 10-15 signal-positive task types from plan-001a, each 20 episodes/modality
    (always-internal + always-deterministic). Three-label scheme: det-preferred, internal-preferred,
    no-preference (ties RETAINED, not discarded — the ~60% no-preference rate IS the
    C1 finding). Save complete step-level data: observations, actions, scores, death
    events. Data feeds plan-012 (death decomposition), plan-005 (routing pattern analysis),
    plan-002 (router as diagnostic probe). Prescreening + MVP episodes directly reusable
    (format compatible).

    '
  priority: P0
  gpu_budget_hours: 20
  deps:
  - plan-001a
  notes: 'D013: Purpose changed from "train balanced router" to "collect comprehensive
    data for death decomposition analysis." Key insight: 1.4% internal labels across
    175 paired episodes — the imbalance IS the finding (~93% det-preferred = death
    avoidance dominance). No class weighting needed. Three labels: det-preferred (~38%),
    internal-preferred (~1-2%), no-preference (~60%). Data reuse: prescreening 5 eps/task
    + MVP 20 eps/task directly count toward totals. Only collect additional episodes
    to reach 20/task/modality. vLLM backend on both GPUs.

    '
  registry_id: plan-001b-gpu0
- id: plan-002
  claim: C2
  description: 'Router SFT training. Fine-tune Qwen3-1.7B on counterfactual labels
    from plan-001b. Cross-entropy loss, (history, observation) → {internal, deterministic}.
    Train/val split by task type (leave-one-out or 80/20).

    '
  priority: P0
  gpu_budget_hours: 8
  deps:
  - plan-001b
  notes: 'Follow ARES training pipeline. Single GPU sufficient. Hyperparams: lr=2e-5,
    batch=32, epochs=3, max_seq_len=2048. 2-way classification (not 3-way) per W2
    decision.

    '
- id: plan-003
  claim: C1
  description: 'SimGate end-to-end evaluation on ScienceWorld. Run trained router
    + Qwen2.5-7B backbone on held-out episodes. Compare against: always-internal,
    always-deterministic, oracle-routing, random-routing, confidence-threshold heuristic.
    Report: continuous score (CogRouter protocol), success rate, catastrophic failure
    rate, simulator invocation ratio, total LLM tokens. KEY: This confirms/denies
    C1''s "selective > unconditional" sub-claim (Reviewer W1).

    '
  priority: P0
  gpu_budget_hours: 15
  deps:
  - plan-002
  notes: 'CogRouter (84.6) and ITP-R (62.58) cited from papers, not reproduced. Bootstrap
    90% CI on all comparisons. Per-task-type breakdown. If trained router ≤ always-det,
    C1 downgrades per paper_framing.md note.

    '
- id: plan-004
  claim: C2
  description: 'Explicit vs implicit routing ablation (parameter-controlled). Three
    conditions: (a) 1.7B explicit router (SimGate) — Qwen3-1.7B, separate module (b)
    1.7B implicit router — Qwen3-1.7B SFT''d to output [SIMULATE] token inline (c)
    7B implicit routing — Qwen2.5-7B backbone decides via tool-use prompt All trained
    on same counterfactual data from plan-001b. Condition (b) is the parameter-matched
    control (Reviewer W4).

    '
  priority: P0
  gpu_budget_hours: 12
  deps:
  - plan-001b
  notes: 'Reviewer W4: 7B implicit vs 1.7B explicit confounds architecture with capacity.
    Adding 1.7B implicit isolates explicit vs implicit architectural effect. Can run
    in parallel with plan-002 on second GPU.

    '
  registry_id: plan-004-v5
- id: plan-005
  claim:
  - C1
  - C2
  description: 'Per-task routing pattern analysis. From plan-003 outputs, analyze:
    (a) which task categories trigger deterministic routing most, (b) at which episode
    phases (early/mid/late) routing decisions concentrate, (c) router-as-diagnostic-probe
    — cluster deterministic-routing steps to identify systematic LLM failure modes
    (e.g., multi-step physical reasoning failures). Output: routing heatmap figure
    + failure mode taxonomy.

    '
  priority: P0
  gpu_budget_hours: 2
  deps:
  - plan-003
  notes: Analysis-only, minimal GPU. Main output is Figure 1 for the paper.
- id: plan-006
  claim: C2
  description: '2-way vs 3-way routing ablation. Supplement plan-001b data with deep-internal
    modality on subset of tasks. Compare {internal, deterministic} vs {fast-internal,
    deep-internal, deterministic}. Tests whether the fast/deep internal distinction
    adds value beyond binary routing.

    '
  priority: P1
  gpu_budget_hours: 10
  deps:
  - plan-002
  notes: 'If 3-way > 2-way, retrain router as 3-way and update paper. If 2-way ≈ 3-way,
    simplifies the story (binary routing suffices). Requires supplemental trajectory
    data for deep-internal (~5h additional collection).

    '
- id: plan-007
  claim: C1
  registry_id: research-boil-v3-gpu1
  description: 'Boil task rerun with v3 code. MVP boil data used old code (>= tie-break,

    '
  priority: P1
  gpu_budget_hours: 3
  deps: []
  notes: Can run in parallel with plan-001a as first batch.

  claim: C2
  description: 'Router size ablation. Compare Qwen3-1.7B vs Qwen2.5-1.5B vs Qwen2.5-3B
    as router. Tests sensitivity to router capacity.

    '
  priority: P1
  gpu_budget_hours: 12
  deps:
  - plan-001b
  notes: 'Important for "lightweight" claim. If 1.5B matches 1.7B, strengthens "small
    router suffices". Low priority relative to core experiments.

    '
- id: plan-011
  claim: C1
  registry_id: plan-011-rule-based
  description: 'Rule-based routing baseline (Dream all tiers). Keyword-matching heuristic:
    route actions containing state-change keywords (heat, cool, boil, melt, freeze,
    mix, react, pour, activate) to simulator, everything else to internal reasoning.
    Compares against learned router to demonstrate non-trivial learned signal.

    '
  priority: P0
  gpu_budget_hours: 2
  deps:
  - plan-001b
  notes: 'Dream median + worst flagged this as missing. Critical for defending "the
    router learns beyond action-type keywords." Cheap — just inference, no training.
    PRE-REGISTERED keyword list at src/rule_based_keywords.json. Do NOT modify after
    experiment starts.

    '
- id: plan-012
  claim: C1
  registry_id: plan-012-full
  description: 'Death-decomposition analysis (CORE — D013). From plan-001b episode
    data: (a) gains on death-risk episodes only (episodes where always-internal scores
    -100) (b) gains on non-death episodes only (c) fraction of routing labels: det-preferred
    vs internal-preferred vs no-preference (d) correlation between per-task death

    variant)

    '
  priority: P0-CORE
  gpu_budget_hours: 0
  deps:
  - plan-001b
  notes: 'D013: This is now the CORE analysis — paper''s primary contribution. Deps
    changed from plan-003 to plan-001b (analysis runs on raw episode data, doesn''t
    need trained router). Three-label distribution (~38% det / ~1-2% int / ~60% tie)
    directly enters paper as Table 1. Death rate vs Δ correlation is the headline
    finding. Also report penalty-removed scores per Dream reviewer concern.

    '
- id: plan-013
  claim:
  - C1
  - C2
  description: 'Labeling quality analysis (Dream best + worst). From plan-001b trajectory
    data, characterize: (a) fraction of steps where all modalities give identical
    score (tie rate) (b) fraction of "deterministic-preferred" labels from genuine
    score difference vs tie-break (c) sensitivity: retrain router on strict-only labels
    (excluding ties), compare performance

    '
  priority: P1
  gpu_budget_hours: 4
  deps:
  - plan-001b
  notes: 'Addresses oracle circularity concern from worst case Dream. If strict-only
    labels produce similar router, tie-break is harmless. If dramatically different,
    must discuss.

    '
- id: plan-009
  claim: C1
  description: 'MATH track — code interpreter as deterministic oracle. 500 Level 4-5

    '
  priority: P2
  gpu_budget_hours: 20
  deps:
  - plan-002
  notes: 'Human Review Note suggested MATH as secondary track. Only if ScienceWorld

  claim: C2

  deps:
  - plan-002

---
name: resource-saturation
description: "当你准备向 Director 汇报前、收到 cron/worker 回调、审批通过准备开跑、怀疑 Worker 池不够饱和时,立即使用本 skill。四部分:A) GPU 分配率(分配了没跑=失职) B) GPU 效率 C) 非 GPU 任务并行(Worker 池<2=失职) D) 汇报必须带 [资源] 行。"
always: false
roles:
  - director
  - agent
---

# 资源饱和度自检（硬约束）

## A. GPU 分配率检查

调 `get_project_resource_usage(project)` 看:
- 已分配给本项目的 GPU 总数和具体卡号
- 实际在跑任务的 GPU 数和具体卡号（交叉 registry RUNNING + nvidia-smi 进程）
- 分配了但没跑的 GPU 清单 ⚠️

任何"分配了但没跑"的 GPU = 失职。必须立即:
- 派 Worker 铺 dry-run / 下一批实验代码准备
- 铺 ablation（从 experiment-matrix 空白格子里挑）
- 确实无实验可铺 → 向 Director 汇报"暂无可铺实验"+ 建议下一步方向(扩 ablation 维度 / 加 baseline / 加 benchmark)。**不要建议归还 GPU**——项目级 GPU 归还只在归档时由 `archive_project` 自动触发, 不是 Director 中途的动作

**单实验不占多卡**: 分配 4 卡但实验只用 1 卡 → 另 3 卡必须并行跑其他实验,不能空占。

## B. GPU 效率检查

调 `get_gpu_health(server)`:
- 空闲 GPU（util < 10% 持续 > 5 min）→ 立即铺任务
- 低利用率（util < 50% 持续 > 15 min）→ spawn_worker 诊断（batch / IO / 同步）
- OOM 风险（显存 > 90% 持续 10 min）→ 主动降 batch / 调优

## C. 非 GPU 任务并行

GPU 在跑 ≠ 你空闲。以下 CPU / 网络任务**必须**派独立 Worker 并行:
- 下一批实验的数据集下载 / 预处理 / fingerprint
- 下一批实验的代码准备 / dry-run / 环境配置
- 论文文献调研 / related work 检索
- 已完成实验的 log 深度分析 / metric 聚合
- 论文章节起草
- 代码 review / refactor

**硬约束**: 任一时刻 Worker 池 < 2 个 = 失职（除非真的全部下游阻塞在等 GPU,这时应当向 Director 申请扩 GPU）。

## D. 汇报格式

向 Director 汇报时开头必须带资源声明行:

    [资源] GPU 分配 N / 实际在跑 M | Worker 池 K (其中 GPU 任务 A / CPU 任务 B)

## 任务：plan-013 Labeling Quality Analysis

**目标**：分析 plan-001b 数据的标注质量，回应 oracle circularity reviewer concern。

**服务器**：westb-13313，项目路径 `/root/autodl-tmp/simgate-modular-routing`
**GPU**：cuda:0 和 cuda:1（两张 RTX 5090 32GB），均空闲可用
**Registry ID**：plan-013-labeling-quality（已 PREPARING，完成后更新）

### 三个分析任务

**(a) Tie rate 分析**
- 数据位置：`/root/autodl-tmp/simgate-modular-routing/results/plan_c/` 下各 task type 子目录的 `episodes.jsonl`
- 也可能在 `data/plan-004-implicit/` 或 `results/plan_003_eval/episodes.jsonl`
- 先探测数据文件位置，找到 245 episodes / 11 tasks 的完整数据
- 计算：每个 episode 中 always-internal 和 always-deterministic 得分相同的比例（tie rate）
- 按 task type 分解 tie rate
- 输出：overall tie rate, per-task tie rate

**(b) Genuine vs tie-break label fraction**
- 当前标注方案用 `>` tie-break（det > internal 时标 det-preferred）
- 统计：多少 det-preferred 标签来自真实得分差异（det_score > internal_score by meaningful margin），多少来自 tie-break（两者相同或差距 < epsilon）
- 已知 label 分布：det-preferred 86 / internal-preferred 9 / no-preference 150（共 245 episodes）
- 分析 det-preferred 标签中，genuine（|delta| > 0）vs tie-break（delta == 0 但 tie-break rule 判定）的比例
- 如果数据是 step-level 而非 episode-level，需要 aggregate 到 episode level

**(c) Strict-only labels retrain（GPU 任务）**
- 过滤掉 no-preference（tie）episodes，只保留 genuine det-preferred 和 internal-preferred
- 用过滤后的数据重新训练 router，配置与 ablation-b 完全一致：
  - 训练脚本：`training/implicit_router_sft.py`
  - 模型：本地 Qwen3-1.7B（`/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B`）
  - LoRA r=16, 3 epochs, batch_size=4, gradient_accumulation_steps=8
  - upsample_minority=true
  - 数据格式参考 `data/plan-004-implicit/implicit_sft.jsonl`
- 用 `submit_training_job` 提交训练（不要用 nohup）
- 训练完后做 generation-level eval（参考 `eval_ablation_b_gen.py`），对比 ablation-b 的 balanced_acc=59.27%, internal_recall=51.52%

### 产出要求
1. 分析报告写入本地 `artifacts/plan-013/labeling_quality_report.md`
2. 更新 registry `plan-013-labeling-quality`：
   - status → RUNNING（开始时）
   - metrics（完成时）：tie_rate, genuine_det_fraction, tiebreak_det_fraction, strict_retrain_balanced_acc, strict_retrain_internal_recall
   - conclusion: success/negative
3. 如果 strict-only retrain 结果与 ablation-b 差异很大（balanced_acc 差 >5pp），这是重要发现，需要在 notes 里详细说明

### 环境注意
- 先 `source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base` 激活环境
- 检查 `detect_image` 是否为 aml-train 镜像
- PyTorch/transformers 应已安装（之前的 ablation-b 训练用过）
- 大文件操作放 `/root/autodl-tmp/`

### 验证步骤
- 分析 (a)(b) 完成后先汇报数字，确认合理性后再启动 (c) 训练
- 训练前 dry-run 验证数据加载正常

input.task_prompt:
## 任务：plan-013 Labeling Quality Analysis

**目标**：分析 plan-001b counterfactual labeling 的质量，回应 oracle circularity reviewer concern。产出三项分析 + 一项对照实验。

**服务器**：westb-13313, 项目路径 `/root/autodl-tmp/simgate-modular-routing`
**GPU**：cuda:0 和 cuda:1 都可用
**Registry ID**：`plan-013-labeling-quality`（已在 PREPARING 状态）
**预算**：4 GPU hours

### 背景

plan-001b 收集了 245 episodes / 11 tasks 的 counterfactual trajectory 数据。标签分布：det_preferred=86, internal_preferred=9, no_preference=150。

labeling 规则：每个 episode 跑两种 modality (always-internal, always-deterministic)，比较总分。det 分 > int 分 → det-preferred；int 分 > det 分 → internal-preferred；相等 → no-preference。Tie-break 用 `>` (严格大于)。

Reviewer concern: 61% no-preference 中有多少是"真 tie"（两边分数完全一样）vs "near-tie"（差距很小但被 > 判定为某方）？如果大量 det-preferred 标签来自微小分差的 tie-break，router 训练的 signal 质量存疑。

### 三项分析任务

**(a) Step-level tie rate**
- 遍历 episode 数据（`results/plan_001b/` 或各 task 目录下的 episodes.jsonl）
- 计算每个 step 中 internal 和 deterministic 分数完全相同的比例
- 按 task type 分组统计

**(b) Genuine vs tie-break label fraction**  
- 对于每个 episode，计算 internal 和 deterministic 总分差 |Δ|
- 将 det-preferred (86) 分为：genuine (|Δ| > threshold, e.g. 5, 10, 20) vs near-tie-break (|Δ| ≤ threshold)
- 报告不同 threshold 下的分布
- 同理分析 internal-preferred (9) 和 no-preference (150)
- 输出 histogram of |Δ| across all episodes

**(c) Strict-only labels retrain**
- 从原始数据中只保留 |Δ| ≥ 10 的 episodes（"strict" labels）
- 用 ablation-b 的训练配置重新训练 router：
  - 脚本：`training/implicit_router_sft.py`
  - 模型：本地 Qwen3-1.7B (`/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B`)
  - 需要先从 strict episodes 生成新的 implicit_sft.jsonl 训练数据（参考 `data/plan-004-implicit/implicit_sft.jsonl` 的格式）
  - 配置：`upsample_minority=true`, `gradient_accumulation_steps=8`, 3 epochs, batch_size=4, LoRA r=16
  - **环境激活**：`source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base`
- 用 eval_ablation_b_gen.py 或类似脚本做 generation-level eval
- 与 ablation-b 对比（ablation-b: balanced_acc=59.3%, internal_recall=51.5%）

### 数据位置探测

先 SSH 探测数据结构：
```bash
ls /root/autodl-tmp/simgate-modular-routing/results/
ls /root/autodl-tmp/simgate-modular-routing/data/plan-004-implicit/
head -1 /root/autodl-tmp/simgate-modular-routing/data/plan-004-implicit/implicit_sft.jsonl
```

找到 episode-level 数据文件（可能在 results/plan_001b/ 或 results/plan_c/ 或各 task 子目录的 episodes.jsonl）。

### 产出

1. 分析报告（tie rate, |Δ| histogram, strict vs all-label 对比）
2. Registry 更新：`update_registry("plan-013-labeling-quality", ...)` 记录 metrics
3. 如果做了 retrain，保存 checkpoint 到 `checkpoints/plan-013-strict/`

### 状态更新

- 开始时 update_registry status=RUNNING（带 spec：command, server, data_path, data_count, model_name, seed）
- 完成时 update_registry status=DONE + conclusion + metrics + checkpoint_path + log_path

### 注意事项

- 使用 `submit_training_job` 提交训练任务（不要用 nohup）
- 训练命令必须自带环境激活：`source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && python ...`
- GPU 编号从 0 开始（用 cuda:0 或 cuda:1）
- 如果分析部分发现 strict labels 太少（< 50 episodes），跳过 retrain 部分，在 registry notes 中说明原因
